author: Aarav K.
title: Insanely comfortable
body: The fit is exactly as described, oversized but not sloppy. Fabric feels premium and the print hasn't cracked after multiple washes.

author: Meera S.
title: Great hoodie, runs slightly large
body: Sized down and it fits perfectly now. Would recommend checking the size chart first.

author: Rohan D.
title: My new everyday tee
body: Soft, breathable, and the print quality is excellent. Ordered a second one in white.

author: Ishita P.
title: Perfect fit
body: True to size and the fabric feels premium for the price point.

author: Kabir M.
title: Solid everyday sweatshirt
body: Warm without being bulky. The mint stripe detail is a nice touch.

author: Ananya T.
title: Functional and stylish
body: Pockets are actually usable, not just for show. Fabric has a nice weight to it.

author: Vivaan R.
title: Statement piece
body: Gets compliments every time I wear it. Print is bold and well placed.

author: Diya N.
title: Worth the hype
body: Limited drop pieces are always a gamble but this one delivered. Heavyweight cotton, great fit.

author: Aditya B.
title: Best tee I own
body: The brush stroke print is even better in person.

author: Sara J.
title: Cozy and unique
body: Garment dye gives it a nice faded look. Runs true to oversized sizing.
